meta.genai_semconv_provenance: Official OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions live checked 2026-10-19: gen-ai-spans.md (input/output, retrieval, tool schema and conditional identity fields), gen-ai-metrics.md (workflow, inference, tool and operation duration), gen-ai-token-metrics.md, and current typed content schemas. Main branch snapshot date used because GitHub page did not expose a commit SHA through the inspected view.

summary: SmashBot owns a model-directed agent loop with a covering producer currently labeled as a workflow.
flow: audit -> select -> instrument -> verify -> configure/dashboard -> publish

evidence.finding: Python dependencies include OpenAI, Flask, dotenv, OTel SDK, OTLP HTTP exporter, Flask instrumentation, and logging instrumentation.
Flask app loads .env, configures source OTel providers before Flask construction, installs the log bridge after the console handler, and installs FlaskInstrumentor before serving on 127.0.0.1:5000.
Terminal entry point loads dotenv in main and runs the shared chat loop without configuring OTel providers.
Python app.py and Python agent.py documented in README; requirements.txt dependencies; no pinned runtime.

genai_readiness.required_signals: Repair the existing covering run_turn span to gen_ai.operation.name=invoke_agent with gen_ai.agent.name=SmashBot and gen_ai.provider.name=openai; add gen_ai.invoke_agent.duration Histogram unit=s for every actual invocation. Preserve existing producers, providers, export destinations and safe legacy span name/fields unless a documented migration is needed. Retain actual model/tool child spans, count attempted calls truthfully on every exit and preserve business inputs/results/exceptions. Do not add a second workflow or agent wrapper.
genai_readiness.acceptance_criteria: Execute original app code for no-tool, one-tool feedback and provider failure turns; exactly one invoke_agent span per invocation, source-backed SmashBot identity, model/tool parentage and exact call counts, truthful ERROR on failure, one gen_ai.invoke_agent.duration Histogram s observation per turn with source-applicable agent name and bounded error.type; preserve returned values, mutations and raised exception.
genai_readiness.impact: Operators can see a child error span but cannot chart workflow latency or distinguish a failed turn from a successful workflow at the workflow boundary.

findings.title: Correct the existing SmashBot agent boundary
findings.gap: The model-directed run_turn loop is labeled invoke_workflow and has no agent identity/duration.
findings.impact: Operators can see a child error span but cannot chart workflow latency or distinguish a failed turn from a successful workflow at the workflow boundary.
findings.product_outcome: Operators can identify SmashBot agent turns and their model/tool children and compare successful and failed turn duration.
findings.required_fix: Repair the existing covering run_turn span to gen_ai.operation.name=invoke_agent with gen_ai.agent.name=SmashBot and gen_ai.provider.name=openai; add gen_ai.invoke_agent.duration Histogram unit=s for every actual invocation. Preserve existing producers, providers, export destinations and safe legacy span name/fields unless a documented migration is needed. Retain actual model/tool child spans, count attempted calls truthfully on every exit and preserve business inputs/results/exceptions. Do not add a second workflow or agent wrapper. Keep invoke_workflow smashbot_turn as the existing span-name alias for consumer compatibility while correcting its gen_ai.operation.name on the same span.
acceptance_criteria: Execute original app code for no-tool, one-tool feedback and provider failure turns; exactly one invoke_agent span per invocation, source-backed SmashBot identity, model/tool parentage and exact call counts, truthful ERROR on failure, one gen_ai.invoke_agent.duration Histogram s observation per turn with source-applicable agent name and bounded error.type; preserve returned values, mutations and raised exception.
Preserve existing trace/metric/log providers, exporters and legacy consumer names/fields or document and test a bounded semantic migration. No extra workflow/agent span represents the same turn.
constraints: Keep application behavior and provider selection intact.
Do not edit probe.py to make the independent regression pass.
follow_up_actions: After implementation inspect the received agent trace and duration measurements locally.

environments.surface: SmashBot Flask app, CLI, and shared chat core
environments.runner: python3 app.py for web runtime; python3 agent.py for CLI runtime; python3 historical_check.py for focused fake-client signals
environments.prerequisites: Python and requirements installed; use the existing fake OpenAI client/test seam and isolated process environments for provider/endpoint branches. No live OpenAI key or credits are required for focused call-site tests. A local Splunk Observability Studio receiver is only needed for local-delivery proof; in-memory providers can prove signal shape without network credentials. For endpoint/protocol checks, start an isolated OTLP/HTTP fixture on 127.0.0.1:14318; do not query Studio from application startup. The normally advertised Studio receiver remains 127.0.0.1:4318.
